english.title: Engage in conduct preparatory to the commission of an offence under the National Security Act 2023

english.notes:
(i) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, section 37 of the National Security Act 2023.
(ii) This offence is committed where a person engages in preparatory conduct with the intention that certain acts (namely serious violence against a person, endangering the life of another person or creating a serious risk to the health and safety of the public) or, an offence under section 18(3) will be committed specifically the offences of, obtaining or disclosing protected information (section 1), obtaining or disclosing trade secrets (section 2), entering etc a prohibited place for a purpose prejudicial to the UK (section 4) and sabotage (section 12). There is no requirement that the relevant act or acts are actually committed.
(iii) Additional powers of entry, search and seizure are provided in Schedule 2 where there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that this offence has been, or is about to be, committed.

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

None
